answer: Assembling that for 95 aliases means 95 times 4 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. Because each atlas escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the pearl ledger records every share and the beacon audit reveals the split. A bond must be split across 4 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. That is 6 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
